message.content: Confirmed failing scenario s2535b000be. Starting triage by shrinking to a minimal reproducing case.
Shrunk to a minimal 2-body violation. Will replay and inspect the failure.
Replay confirmed identical. Examining the exact states around the momentum jump.

Small timestep suppresses the momentum violation. Testing mass symmetry to confirm.
